1.
Heard Sri Rishabh Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Udai Bhan Pandey, learned Addl. Government Advocate, and perused the record.

2. By means of the instant application the applicant Irfan Ali S/o Ahmad Ali seeks bail in Case Crime No. 137 of 2022, under sections 376(2)N, 504/506, I.P.C., and section 5L/6, 17, Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, P.S. Katra Bazar, District Gonda.
3.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a First Information Report (F.I.R.) lodged on 04.05.2022 against three named accused persons, including the applicant, alleging that the co-accused Shahabuddin Ansari was having a love affair with the informant's sister Neetu Pal; that the informant had settled her sister's marriage elsewhere, and the accused persons got the proposed relation broken; that the F.I.R. also alleges that the co-accused Shahabuddin had raped the informant's sister at 01.00 a.m. on 28.04.2022 and again at about 7.00 p.m. on 02.05.2022 and the applicant and the other co-accused were standing at some distance.

In the statement of the informant and that of the victim recorded under section 161 Cr.P.C. the F.I.R. allegations were reiterated, but in the statement of the victim recorded under section 164,
Cr.P.C. she stated that all the three accused persons have raped her.
5. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail-application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.

6. It has been stated by the learned counsel for the applicant that Shahabuddin Ansari has been granted bail by the learned Sessions Judge/Spl. Judge, POCSO Act, Gonda, in Criminal Appeal No.
43 of 2022, treating him juvenile.

entities.text: Sessions Judge/Spl. Judge, POCSO Act, Gonda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail-application, but could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the facts that the F.I.R. alleges commission of rape by the co-accused Shahabuddin Ansari and in the statement recorded under section 161, Cr.P.C. also there is no allegation of commission of rape by the applicant and this allegation has been levelled for the first time in the statement of the victim recorded under section 164, Cr.P.C. coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 05.05.2022, without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
